audit.whatIsWrong: Both level charts read Gnar/Gnar/Gnar/Skill/Gnar/Skill/Gnar, giving Gnar the 2-item stage outright. The packet chart says Gnar,Gnar,Skill,Skill,Skill,Vayne,Vayne and the content prose agrees with the packet, not the enums.
audit.why: whys[2] calls level 3 'pure form RNG' (Skill), whys[4] calls the mid stretch a coin-flip (Skill), whys[5] says the lane tilts to her on her first crit item and whys[6] says she reclaims the duel and out-scales hard. late/'Stop trying to 1v1 her' says the same. Marking 2+ items as a Gnar win contradicts the page's own body text.
audit.corrected: Gnar / Gnar / Skill / Skill / Skill / Vayne / Vayne, proposed as one atomic group across both layers.

audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer spike language was generic ('Stridebreaker is your spike') and never named Vayne's real spikes.
audit.why: Vayne's spikes are her first crit item (Silver Bolts converting) and Final Hour at 6 (100/85/70s, granting invisibility during Tumble and a reduced Tumble cooldown). Gnar's spike is a banked Rage bar, not an item.
audit.corrected: Phase whys now key to Silver Bolts' first-item conversion, Final Hour's invisibility, and Gnar's Rage availability.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer never states Condemn's range or cooldown, never states that Silver Bolts is percent-max-HP TRUE damage, and never states the flagged mutual-displacement interaction.
audit.why: Condemn is 550 range on 20/18/16/14/12s — it outreaches Gnar's 475 Hop (E), so she can knock you away from outside your own gap-closer. Silver Bolts' third hit is true damage, so Mega Gnar's armour and MR — the whole reason Mega wins trades — do nothing. And both champions carry displacement (GNAR! vs Condemn): whoever lands it first owns the trade.
audit.corrected: Stated Condemn 550/20s vs Hop 475, Silver Bolts as percent-max-HP true damage, Tumble 6s falling to 2s, and the displacement race.

audit.why: Condemn 20s at rank 1 and Tumble's 6s-to-2s decay are the two windows that decide when you can step up.

edits.before: Boomerang + hop kite wins every melee matchup early. Identify how Vayne contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Mini's ranged auto plus a Boomerang wins the first trade — Silver Bolts needs three hits and Tumble only resets her auto.

edits.before: Rage management is the champion — track your own bar. Only take the trade when Vayne's Condemn is down.
edits.after: Level-2 Hyper third-hit proc plus a Boomerang chunks her and shoves before she can tumble-kite back out.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Vayne must walk into your range.
edits.after: Form RNG: a Mega Wallop stun wins it, but a Mini body with Rage spent gets tumble-kited on a 4s Q and chipped.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Condemn's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Whether you win here is your Rage bar, not her cooldowns — Condemn is 550 range and outreaches your 475 Hop either way.

edits.before: Mega + R against a wall is the best engage top lane owns. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Vayne's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: You gain no new spell at 6; Final Hour gives her invisibility on Tumble, so only commit when Mega is already banked.

edits.before: Stridebreaker is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Condemn's cooldown.
edits.after: Her first crit item plus three-stack Silver Bolts starts converting on your Mega HP.

edits.before: Two items on: your pattern is at full power. Vayne carry threat 9.5/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Silver Bolts' percent-max-HP true damage ignores Mega's armour and MR, and Condemn pins you — teamfight, never duel.

edits.before: Dive her early — Mega-CC her, all-in early. Gnar wins the Condemn cooldown windows.
edits.after: Dive her early before Silver Bolts stacks. Condemn is 550 range — it outreaches your Hop.

edits.before: Mega-CC her early and all-in. Track Condemn before every commit and keep the wave on your side.
edits.after: Mega-CC her early and all-in. Land Wallop before Condemn (20s at rank 1) throws you into a wall.

edits.before: Vayne wins by landing Condemn, denying your pattern, and kiting you off the wave.
edits.after: Vayne wins by stacking three Silver Bolts true hits and Condemning you into a wall.

edits.before: Wall-stun. Don’t get pinned. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Condemn is 20s at rank 1 and 550 range — bait it out, then commit.

edits.before: Vayne wastes Condemn — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: A wasted Condemn means 20 seconds with no knockback — commit.

edits.before: That is Vayne's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: Tumble is 300 range on a 4s cooldown — fight beside open ground, not against walls.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Three Silver Bolts hits deal percent-max-HP true damage to Mega.

edits.before: Getting caught at zero rage right after Mega ends — that 15-second window is when Gnars die.
edits.after: Free farm buys her crit items; Final Hour's invisibility on Tumble then wins every skirmish.

edits.before: Track Vayne's Condemn: Wall-stun. Don’t get pinned. When it is down — Boomerang-W + R her.
edits.after: Condemn (E, 20s, 550) knocks back and wall-stuns — both sides displace, so land Wallop first.

edits.before: - Vayne Condemn: matchup-defining — Wall-stun. Don’t get pinned. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Vayne Condemn (E): 20s at rank 1, 550 range — a wall-stun that outreaches your 475 Hop; stay off walls. - Tumble: 6s at rank 1, down to 2s. - Final Hour: 100s, invisibility on every Tumble.

notes: Content layer was already strong and correctly named — only its win[] enums were wrong. Full layer was boilerplate ('Stridebreaker is your spike', 'his' pronouns for Vayne throughout tradeGood/breakdown.feeding) and has been given real numbers. Pronoun defect: tradeGood, tradeBad, breakdown.feeding and report[3] all call Vayne 'his' — these are inside length-banded prose I did not otherwise need to touch; flagged rather than churned. Not verified: whether Condemn's knockback can interrupt Gnar's Hop mid-dash, or whether GNAR!'s wall-stun and Condemn's wall-stun cancel each other on simultaneous cast — kit text does not say, so no copy asserts it.
